title: MEIKO — Happy Anniversary! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
I'm really looking forward to today's show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Tsukasa and everyone really seemed excited!
“Our present for your anniversary will be a show just for you!”☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
But, I wonder what kind of story it'll be?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Maybe one where there are suddenly a hundred MEIKOs?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: A hundred of me?! I feel like I'd be able to do anything, with that many of myself around!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, look! It's starting!

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Oh no... What should I do? The sun's already done down.”

rows.Speaker: Narrator
rows.Line: “For this young girl, a night all alone held nothing but terrors. Even the bustling town streets seemed like a parade of terrible giants.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Poor thing...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (The young girl plans to make stew to celebrate her parents' anniversary...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But she can't find milk or cheese anywhere, and now the sun's gone down...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wonder what's gonna happen...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“I'm scared...
Mommy, Daddy...”
se_walk_women_002_1
“Oh? Excuse me, miss! Are you okay?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Who are you, lady?”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “I just happened to be passing by. Call me MEIKO!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh? It's me?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “What's wrong, sweetie? Can you tell me?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Um, so...”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, by MEIKO, they mean you, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She talks just the way you do, so I think so. But I never expected MEIKO to appear as a character in the show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “I see, so that's what happened! Hmm, still...”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “You were so brave to come out on this errand. I'd like to show you that this town isn't a scary place at all.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
“Huh?!
W-Where are we going?!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “Right over here! See the buildings right there? Their windows are shaped like stars.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “When it gets dark, the lights inside shine out, and it's like a beautiful starry sky!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Wow, you're right!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “Hehe, there's a smile. Okay, let's get your shopping done! I know a place nearby that sells cheese...”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehehe... She's just like you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Considerate, bright and cheerful, and kind.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “MEIKO! Thank you for bringing me home!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “Hehe, it was no problem at all. I had fun, too! See you around!”
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Oh, please wait a moment!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Um... Please take this! As thanks!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “This is... A plushie?”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “Yes. Thank you for rescuing me.”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: “You showed me not all scary things are scary, and taught me so much... I'm so glad I met you!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “I'm glad, too!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “Now, your parents must be waiting, so hurry on home. And wish them a happy anniversary from me!”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Did you enjoy our performance?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was so surprised to see myself appear in your show! Thank you for this wonderful present!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, it's too early for thanks just yet! We have more presents for you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, ta-da! Here's a present just for you, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, is that the plushie the girl from the show gave her?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's right. We all feel the same way the girl did, after all.
“We're so glad we met you.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We all agreed that once the show was over, we'd give this to you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, I should be thanking you all!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm so grateful to have met you all. It's made me so happy to watch over you as you grow.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now then, I can't just sit still after getting such wonderful presents. I'll have to repay you! How about with a song?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait just a minute, MEIKO! If you repay our celebration, we'll have to repay your repayment!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe, it'll be a repaying battle!
Wait, doesn't that mean we would get to celebrate every day?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's true, we would get to hold as many celebrations as... Wait, no!!! Once we start, we would never, ever end!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: MEIKO, they're being so sincere. Best to just go ahead and accept.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe, I guess so!
I really do want to sing now, though...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of songs... Isn't it starting soon?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed it is! There's actually a celebratory performance being held for the MEIKO in our world!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The me in your world! I'm so curious.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I thought you would be, so I brought a tablet. Why don't we all watch together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay! I wanna see!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Here, everyone get in close so you can all see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I wonder if the me from their world has lots of people around her to celebrate, too.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Hehe, not only do I get to see a show starring myself, I get to see a show from another me. This has already been so much fun!)
